en.after_childbirth_mothers_often_face_phys: After childbirth, mothers often face physical discomfort, emotional changes, and uncertainty while caring for a newborn. Finding clear, accessible, and culturally relevant recovery information can be difficult.
en.herbloom_brings_recovery_education_emoti: HerBloom brings recovery education, emotional wellbeing support, nutrition information, tracking tools, and helpful reminders together in one caring space — so mothers can feel more informed and supported throughout recovery.
en.a_simple_guided_journey_with_helpful_too: A simple, guided journey with helpful tools for a more informed and supported postpartum recovery.
en.sign_up_and_share_a_few_details_about_yo: Sign up and share a few details about your recovery journey.
en.monitor_your_physical_recovery_mood_rest: Monitor your physical recovery, mood, rest, and daily wellbeing.
en.explore_mother_friendly_nutrition_tips_c: Explore mother-friendly nutrition tips, care guides, and reminders.
en.ask_questions_and_find_helpful_education: Ask questions and find helpful educational information with our AI companion.
en.herbloom_is_a_postpartum_recovery_compan: HerBloom is a postpartum recovery companion designed to make recovery information, tracking tools, and wellbeing support more accessible to Sri Lankan and Tamil mothers.
en.to_help_mothers_feel_informed_supported_: To help mothers feel informed, supported, and respected throughout their postpartum recovery journey.
en.designed_with_sri_lankan_mothers_in_mind: Designed with Sri Lankan mothers in mind
en.recovery_nutrition_and_wellbeing_in_one_: Recovery, nutrition, and wellbeing in one place
en.quick_answers_to_help_you_get_started: Quick answers to help you get started.
en.herbloom_is_a_postpartum_recovery_compan: HerBloom is a postpartum recovery companion offering recovery tracking, wellbeing tools, nutrition education, reminders, and AI-assisted educational support.
en.is_it_only_for_c_section_mothers: Is it only for C-section mothers?
en.no_herbloom_is_designed_for_mothers_reco: No. HerBloom is designed for mothers recovering from both vaginal and C-section deliveries.
en.do_i_need_an_account_to_explore: Do I need an account to explore?
en.an_account_is_needed_for_personal_tracki: An account is needed for personal tracking. A guest experience for general educational information is planned.
en.herbloom_is_designed_with_privacy_in_min: HerBloom is designed with privacy in mind. Appropriate security and access controls are important parts of the application.
en.can_i_use_it_in_tamil: Can I use it in Tamil?
en.herbloom_is_being_developed_with_english: HerBloom is being developed with English and Tamil support.
en.no_herbloom_is_an_educational_companion_: No. HerBloom is an educational companion, not a medical diagnosis or treatment service.
en.a_caring_all_in_one_companion_for_your_p: A caring, all-in-one companion for your postpartum recovery journey. Discover supportive tools and information designed around you.
en.social_media_links_will_be_added_when_of: Social media links will be added when official accounts are available.
en.herbloom_provides_educational_informatio: HerBloom provides educational information and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
